_meta.description: Estimated Mt values (average marks of top 0.1% candidates). NOT officially published by IITs. These are estimated from historical score distributions and topper scorecards.
_meta.disclaimer: IITs do not publish Mt values. These are estimates derived from available scorecard data and should be treated as approximations.

2024.source: Estimated from GATE 2024 scorecard data, topper interviews, and rank distributions

2025.source: Estimated from GATE 2025 scorecard data and topper score analysis

2026.source: Projected based on 2024-2025 trend. Will be refined when 2026 data is available

2024.source: Estimated from limited DA paper data. First year of DA paper.

2025.source: Refined from 2024-2025 DA paper score data.
